experiment: AntMaze V6 mainline pilot: observational (O) vs counterfactual-oracle (CF) positive futures, matched offline CRL

dataset.training_split: the whole d05 file is the training set (critic anchors and actor rows); evaluation = fresh native draws; the old 100 held-out and the 30 Cnew reserved pool episodes are excluded from d05 by construction

start_agent.role: continuation policy (mode) of arm CF and the actor initialisation of both arms
start_agent.identity: exp_detour_ratio d05 vanilla actor, training seed 0 (SUMMARY table row "d05 vanilla seed 0") -- RE-DERIVED with the same recipe and seed (see rederivation); the original file was lost

joint_van_d05/seed_0/branch_manifest.jso.note: discount 0.999 deviates from the frozen V6 recipe (0.99) on purpose: plan section 0

critics_van_d05/seed_0/branch_manifest.j.note: discount 0.999 deviates from the frozen V6 recipe (0.99) on purpose: plan section 0

joint_purebc_d05/seed_0/branch_manifest..note: discount 0.999 deviates from the frozen V6 recipe (0.99) on purpose: plan section 0

data_provenance_check.observation contract: 29-dim Ant state + goal xy (31 columns); the env privileged channel never enters _flatten

rederivation.authorised_by_user: 2026-09-19: if it cannot be recovered, choose (b)
rederivation.reason: the 2026-09-18 chain existed only on node 30021, which died; no copy anywhere
rederivation.recipe: exp_detour_ratio / node_ratio.sh d05 stages 1, 3, 7: pure BC 100k (V6_JOINT_FRESH=1, V6_BC_COEF=1.0, frozen, balanced BC rows) seed 0 -> vanilla critic 30k seed 0 (vanilla_g0999_d05 = critics_van_d05) -> actor from the pure-BC init, frozen critic, bc 0.05, balanced BC rows, 30k, seed 0

start_agent.historical_training_note: the start agent itself was produced by the exp_detour_ratio chain (pure-BC 100k init, frozen vanilla critic 30k, displacement-balanced BC rows, 30k): diagnostic components of ITS history, not of this pilot's training procedure (contract section 1c)
start_agent.alternative_not_used: vanilla_g0999_d05/seed_0/final.pkl (the jointly trained vanilla run's own actor, never evaluated on natural draws) -- not used: the report row "d05 vanilla seed 0" is the actor above

anchors.law: K i.i.d. draws: episode uniform over the d05 file, then row uniform over [0, L_e - 1); unique rows with weight = multiplicity / K (the recipe buffer's own anchor law, subsampled)
anchors.weights_identical_across_arms: by construction (one file read by both arms)

arm_O.positive_futures: recorded rows t+1..L_e-1 of the anchor episode
arm_O.future_law: P(m) proportional to gamma^m, m = 1..L_e-1-t (truncated at the episode end)
arm_O.negatives: in-batch (the other anchors' positive goals): the arm's own goal marginal

arm_CF.query_action: the logged torque a_t, executed once
arm_CF.continuation: start agent, mode tanh(loc), closed-loop from the state after the query step
arm_CF.hidden_draws: hazard latents, both clocks and rock jitter redrawn from the priors; seed 132000000 + anchor_id
arm_CF.horizon: absolute 800: a branch from time t runs at most 800 - t steps
arm_CF.terminal_handling: ends on the first reach frame, on death, or at the horizon; every outcome kept (no success or route filter)
arm_CF.goal_hold: none (matched to the recorded episodes, which end on their reach frame); the historical branch replays parked to the horizon
arm_CF.future_law: P(m) proportional to gamma^m, m = 1..len-1 over the branch rows (truncated at the branch end)
arm_CF.negatives: in-batch: the arm's own goal marginal (documented, not forced to match arm O)
arm_CF.existing_d05_branches: replay_policy_d05.npz NOT reused: continuation = the d05 pure-BC walker, dense strata + every-60th anchors, goal hold to the horizon, 2 draws, extra sampled candidates -- none of it matches this contract

actor_stream.both_arms: TrajectoryBuffer over the d05 file, default law: episode uniform, row uniform over [0, L_e - 1), future goal geometric gamma^(j-i) truncated at the episode end (the recipe's own draw); seed 20000 + training seed
actor_stream.pairing: random_goals 0: critic term at (s_i, g_j) with the sampled action; BC = -log pi(a_i | s_i, g_j) on the same rows; bc 0.05
actor_stream.reset_restriction: none (the whole row range is eligible)
actor_stream.interface_note: critic and actor batches are separate streams (crl.losses.build_learner(separate_actor_batch=True)); the loss algebra is the original's, the pairing of rows is not the shared-batch implementation

training.update_rule: one critic Adam step and one actor Adam step per optimizer update, both every update (joint)
training.critic_init: fresh: crl.train's init_state at PRNGKey(seed) (identical across arms for a seed)
training.actor_init: policy_params of the start agent; fresh Adam state for both optimizers
training.discount_note: gamma 0.999 = the branch-chain recipe (the frozen V6 ladder used 0.99); pinned, not swept

evaluation.same_episodes: one env seed; the six hidden streams and the reset pose are consumed at reset only, so episode k is identical for every policy (checked post hoc)

comparisons.primary: CF - O success (mode), paired on the 300 common episodes within each training seed, then over the 3 paired seeds
comparisons.practical: CF - start and O - start success on the same episodes
secondary_metrics: success with / without an active hazard
comparisons.rule: improvement = mean over the 3 paired seeds > 2 x the seed s.e. of the paired differences AND 3/3 seeds in the same direction; ties are never counted against; evaluation uncertainty (episode-paired bootstrap, seeds fixed) reported separately from seed variability
comparisons.secondary_diagnostic: true-reset candidate ranking: secondary only; not a substitute for policy improvement; the old mixed Cdev gate does not reject
comparisons.no_selection: no checkpoint, continuation, seed or batch source is chosen after evaluation
